title: Adaptive Workplace
subtitle: Occupancy + HVAC + bookings → energy value without compromising comfort

valueIntent.objective: Reduce estate cost and progress decarbonisation
valueIntent.benefitHypothesis: Annual addressable cost: £180k; illustrative 8% opportunity = £14.4k before delivery costs
valueIntent.riskBoundary: IEQ / ventilation; variable occupancy and data privacy
valueIntent.autonomy: L1 recommendation / L2 ticket with approval

agents.name: Signal Steward
agents.mandate: Normalise source events, provenance, freshness and completeness

agents.name: Context & Graph
agents.mandate: Resolve assets, zones, owners, policy context and source conflicts

agents.name: Value Reasoner
agents.mandate: Evaluate materiality, counterfactuals, benefit ownership and confidence

agents.name: Intervention Planner
agents.mandate: Form choices with expected impact, dependencies and failure modes

agents.name: Policy & Risk Gate
agents.mandate: Enforce role permissions, OT safety, privacy, human approval

agents.name: Action Broker
agents.mandate: Issue authorised tickets and controlled commands; handle receipts and rollback

agents.name: Outcome Auditor
agents.mandate: Compare before/after, control for confounders, sign benefits and improve graph

valueStreams: Save money · Protect experience · Reduce carbon
ciscoRole: Spaces location/occupancy; enterprise networking; Splunk correlation; Webex/room usage where contractually supported

workflow.name: Observe
workflow.description: New source events arrive and are quality checked.
workflow.detail: Occupancy has fallen but HVAC remains active in a wing with no scheduled meetings.

workflow.name: Contextualise
workflow.description: Join physical, operational and business context.
workflow.detail: Occupancy has fallen but HVAC remains active in a wing with no scheduled meetings.

workflow.name: Hypothesise
workflow.detail: A bounded schedule adjustment could reduce waste while preserving accessibility and air quality.

workflow.name: Plan
workflow.description: Compare interventions, cost, confidence and risk.
workflow.detail: Propose an after-hours HVAC schedule review in the west wing; confirm IEQ and booking overrides before any change.

workflow.name: Guard
workflow.description: Apply the delegated authority and safety boundaries.
workflow.detail: Human FM approval required; preserve minimum ventilation, accessible-user exceptions and emergency overrides.

workflow.name: Approve
workflow.description: The accountable human accepts or rejects the proposed action.

workflow.name: Act
workflow.description: Create authorised workflow actions with audit and rollback.
workflow.detail: Create a SIMULATED FM work order for a controlled trial; do not send a BMS command.

workflow.name: Verify
workflow.description: Check pre/post data and counterfactual validity.
workflow.detail: Compare normalised kWh per occupied-hour across matched evenings; include weather, exceptions and comfort complaints.

workflow.name: Learn
workflow.description: Publish verified evidence, or record unresolved gaps.
workflow.detail: If the trial shows attributable benefit, extend the value hypothesis to an operating playbook.

outcome.benefitHypothesis: Annual addressable cost: £180k; illustrative 8% opportunity = £14.4k before delivery costs
outcome.verification: Compare normalised kWh per occupied-hour across matched evenings; include weather, exceptions and comfort complaints.
